newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal's Petrogal in talks with Morocco's Somepi.
newsitem.headline: Portugal's Petrogal in talks with Morocco's Somepi.

text.p: Petrogal-Petroleos de Portugal has had talks with Morocco's Somepi about taking a stake in the distribution company, a Petrogal spokesman said.
But the negotiations have been suspended while Petrogal discusses the move with Saudi Arabia's Aramco which is taking a 27.5 percent stake in the Portuguese state-controlled company.
"Petrogal is really interested and had negotiations with Somepi...but the negotiation will only resume when the future partner (Saudi Aramco) gives its opinion," the spokesman said.
He was confirming a report in Tuesday's Diario Economico. The newspaper said that the proposed stake could go as high as 50 percent.
Saudi Aramco has no presence in the Moroccan market where Societe Marocaine d'Expansion des Produits Industriels (SOMEPI) is a leading distributor with some 100 outlets, the spokesman said.
